mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_request_log ( client_request_id, employee_no, popup_id, api_path, http_method, client_ip, request_received_at, response_completed_at, elapsed_milliseconds, http_status_code, success_yn, error_code, error_message, request_summary, response_summary, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{clientRequestId}, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_user WHERE employee_no = #{userId} ) THEN #{userId} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM popup_notice WHERE popup_id = #{popupId} ) THEN #{popupId} ELSE NULL END, #{apiPath}, #{httpMethod}, #{clientIp}, #{requestReceivedAt}, #{responseCompletedAt}, #{elapsedMilliseconds}, #{httpStatusCode}, #{successYn}, #{errorCode}, NULL, #{requestSummary}, NULL, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userId}, ''), 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userId}, ''), 'SYSTEM') )
